facts.fact: The Government of Benin's national data-exchange dashboard shows an instance with 138,174,337 total requests exchanged, including 32,685,727 in the last 30 days.
The dashboard says the instance has 73 members, 176 information systems and 512 services, with ANATT, ANIP and DGI the top providers.
The dashboard reports 138,174,337 total requests and 57,322,278 requests in the last 12 months, statistics updated 11 July 2026.
